title: Bacterial 16S rRNA Tree
goal: A practitioner can visually assess the Bacterial 16S rRNA Tree scenario using its published diagram convention.

rubric.must: A rooted branching tree visibly shows the stated sister taxa and their clade relationships.
Horizontal branch lengths visibly vary to encode the supplied evolutionary distances.
The named taxa are legible at the tree tips.
The named clade is visibly highlighted distinctly from the rest of the tree.
A visible scale or distance label identifies the evolutionary-distance interpretation.

ideal.notes: Drafted by Codex from the source and the rubric, without seeing the engine's own output. It preferred the svg: The SVG provides a clear rooted tree with varied branch lengths, legible tip labels, a distinctly blue Proteobacteria clade, and a distance scale, while the picture explicitly makes branch lengths schematic.
